title: Vande Mataram row: Is Cong taking a calculated gamble or walking into BJP's trap?
content: The Congress party's choice to sing two stanzas of Vande Mataram sparked intense backlash from the BJP, with Union ministers accusing them of engaging in appeasement politics and being responsible for the partition. Congress leaders defended their actions by invoking historical importance, while they criticized the BJP for politicizing the issue. This controversy underscores Congress's struggle to navigate its revival strategy amidst opposing pressures.

title: Crude awakening: As Russia, Iran face Trump heat, can Venezuela fill India’s oil gap?
content: What happens when the world stops buying Iran oil due to the threat of secondary sanctions? Where will India procure crude from if it faces tariffs of up to 100% for its Russian crude oil imports? The Middle East crisis has pushed Russia’s share in India’s crude oil basket to over 50%.

title: India vs Sri Lanka: The good, old grind takes centrestage in Colombo
content: Sri Lanka's stubborn lower order turned a seemingly straightforward day into a gruelling Test for India, leaving the visitors with 12 wickets to take and limited time to force a 2-0 series win.

title: Scientists built a 'rainbow on a chip' that could help 6G carry more signals
content: Scientists have developed a "rainbow on a chip" system. This microchip generates multiple stable light frequencies simultaneously. These frequencies can convert into millimetre waves for future 6G networks. The technology also shows promise for precise timing in quantum applications. Further development is needed before real-world implementation.

title: Gurgaon rain chaos: Massive sinkhole swallows service road on Delhi-Jaipur highway
content: A service road near IFFCO Chowk caved in, creating a large crater and disrupting traffic. Authorities closed the affected stretch while assessing damage to a major sewer line beneath the road. Heavy rains exacerbated existing infrastructure issues, causing waterlogging and stranding school buses. This incident follows several other road collapses and sinkholes reported across Gurgaon recently. Repair work on the damaged sewer line is scheduled to begin soon.

title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125m school to shut after 10 yrs
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution for low-income families, has closed its doors after a decade. Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, prompting the board's unanimous decision to shut down. While offering extensive support services, the school's academic results did not meet state benchmarks. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative is providing financial support for the transition and educational savings accounts.

title: Former San Francisco gun club becomes public recreation space after cleanup
content: San Francisco is on the lookout for private partners to rejuvenate a 9.5-acre lakeside site, previously a shooting range that has been extensively cleaned up. The city envisions this area transforming into a vibrant public park and recreation hub, inviting proposals for water access, community spaces, and outdoor activities. This project aims to restore nearly a century of waterfront land for public enjoyment.

title: Disney offers early retirement packages to employees, HR sends email to executives
content: Disney is offering voluntary early retirement to senior leaders across its units. This initiative is part of a broader cost-reduction campaign and ongoing transformation. Eligible executives will receive an enhanced departure plan recognizing their years of service. The program includes separation pay and continued benefits for those who accept. This voluntary offer precedes further involuntary staff reductions planned for next year.

title: ‘Really hacked off’: Carse in handcuffs leaves captain Root ‘really disappointed’
content: England captain Joe Root is deeply disappointed by another player's off-field incident. Fast bowler Brydon Carse was seen in handcuffs outside a nightclub early Sunday. This event has prompted an investigation by the England Cricket Regulator. Root stated that these recurring mistakes detract from the team's on-field performance. He acknowledged the need for players to understand their responsibilities away from the game.

title: In a first, Rafales take on China's J-16 fighters; why India is watching closely
content: Chinese J-16 fighter jets engaged Egyptian Rafale aircraft in simulated air combat. This exercise provided China rare training against a Western fighter type. The PLA Air Force gained valuable data on Rafale capabilities and tactical behavior. India is closely monitoring this development as it involves a similar fighter. This encounter offers China insights for potential future air engagements.

title: How Alex Ovechkin reportedly racked up 33 traffic fines in Russia
content: Rumors say that Washington Capitals captain Alex Ovechkin may have accumulated 33 traffic tickets during the summer months in Russia, with the fines totalling an estimated 82,000 rubles. Those violations included speeding, parking violations and unpaid toll-road charges, according to reports. The surprise offseason move comes as Ovechkin prepares for his 22nd NHL season following a new contract with Washington.

title: Andy Reid remains noncommittal on Patrick Mahomes' Week 1 return
content: Patrick Mahomes' injury status for the season opener against the Denver Broncos has remained uncertain as Andy Reid weighed in on it.

title: Could Gavin McKenna force Auston Matthews into a new role in Toronto?
content: The arrival of Gavin McKenna has sparked discussion about how the Toronto Maple Leafs could use their latest offensive talent. With William Nylander and John Tavares already established as productive forwards, McKenna could provide head coach Jim Hiller with another option. The biggest question is if his emergence could eventually change Auston Matthews’ familiar role in Toronto’s forward group.

title: Delhi Master Plan 2047: 40L homes, land pooling to reshape NCT's real estate
content: Delhi's Master Plan 2047 sets forth a comprehensive strategy for urban development, emphasizing both the revitalization of existing neighborhoods and the strategic expansion into undeveloped areas. The ambitious proposal aims to generate around forty lakh affordable housing units, supported by initiatives like land pooling to enhance urban infrastructure and ensure accessibility. Additionally, measures will be taken to regularize unauthorized colonies, providing greater security in property ownership.

title: Faridabad: Woman helps ‘lover’ kill husband, bury body near home
content: Faridabad police arrested a wife and her alleged lover for murder.  The deceased husband was killed after discovering their affair.  He was allegedly intoxicated and struck on the head.  The couple then buried the body near their home.  Both accused were apprehended within twenty-four hours of the discovery.

title: EPL 2026/27, Gameweek 1: Record-breaking numbers that headlined season opener
content: Gameweek 1 delivered landmark wins, dramatic late goals and standout individual milestones. Arsenal began their title defence strongly, while Arteta reached 150 Premier League victories. Hull stunned Manchester United, Liverpool extended their unbeaten opening-day streak to 14 seasons, and Ipswich ended a 30-year wait. Chelsea also made history with João Pedro’s 31-second opener, while promoted sides made an impressive early impact.

title: 'You have to trust yourself': Anushka Sharma on parenting with Virat Kohli
content: Anushka Sharma found motherhood strengthened her self-belief and decision-making abilities. She chose to scale back acting to prioritize her daughter's needs. This shift reflects a growing confidence in personal judgment over external validation. Modern parenting often involves intense comparison and pressure to prove sufficiency. Sharma's experience highlights trusting one's understanding of their child and family.

title: NSA Ajit Doval holds 25th India-China border talks with Wang Yi
content: In a significant diplomatic encounter, National Security Adviser Ajit Doval engaged with Chinese Vice President Han Zheng in Beijing. Their discussions centered on boundary issues to ensure peace, while also enhancing economic and political ties. The leaders are committed to managing differences and promoting long-term bilateral cooperation, following a series of recent high-level discussions between Modi and Xi.

title: 'You're just wasting time bro': Sarfaraz Khan's sledging goes viral - Watch
content: Sarfaraz Khan played a key role as India’s substitute fielder against Sri Lanka, constantly chatting with batters from short leg. His sledging appeared to distract captain Dhananjaya de Silva and Niroshan Dickwella, who were dismissed soon after. Sarfaraz told Dhananjaya, “Don't be scared. You are the captain. Come on, bro," as India strengthened their position.

title: Op 'Economic Outcast': US sanctions 4 Indian firms for Iran trade links
content: The United States has imposed sanctions on four Indian companies involved in Iran's oil trade, aiming to disrupt Tehran's global revenue streams. Among those targeted, Sadashiva Overseas and PP Softtech have been linked to the import of significant quantities of Iranian petroleum products. Additionally, Prakrutees Infra participated in similar transactions from May 2023 to February 2026, highlighting the ongoing US efforts against Iran's illicit economic activities.

title: ‘Badly bruised’: Morkel reveals why Pant did not keep as Jurel took gloves
content: Rishabh Pant is dealing with a severely bruised shoulder that is affecting his performance as a wicketkeeper. On day three of the Test match, India's bowlers had a challenging time dismissing the Sri Lankan team, but Prasidh Krishna exhibited commendable skill with his energetic spells. Mohammed Siraj also put in a tireless effort on a tough pitch, as India pushe for a swift end to enforce the follow-on.

title: Late-night incidents shaming English cricket: Cook says ‘Just have some brain cells’
content: The recent late-night incident involving England cricketer Brydon Carse has reignited questions about the team's off-field behavior. This incident mirrors past occurrences with teammates like Harry Brook and Ben Duckett. With the England Cricket Regulator investigating Carse's actions during domestic duty, concerns arise about the impact of such events on the team's cultural evolution and the limits of acceptable conduct.

title: 8 years apart, spot the difference: Gurgaon's annual infrastructure betrayal
content: Gurgaon experienced significant disruption from recent monsoon rains. Major roads flooded, causing extensive traffic jams and stranding many commuters. Despite substantial infrastructure spending, the city faces recurring waterlogging issues. Civic body vacancies and a focus on symptoms hinder long-term resilience efforts. Changing rainfall patterns necessitate updated urban planning for future preparedness.

title: Colombo Test sees third ICC punishment as Jayasuriya joins Jaiswal, Fernando
content: Sri Lanka spinner Prabath Jayasuriya received an official reprimand and one demerit point. This sanction occurred after he breached the ICC Code of Conduct during the Colombo Test. Jayasuriya struck boundary wedges with his bat after being dismissed leg-before wicket. He joins Yashasvi Jaiswal and Asitha Fernando, who were also punished earlier. Three players have now been sanctioned in this ongoing Test match.

title: 2nd Test: India struggle to finish off tail as Sonal, Pasindu lead Lanka resistance
content: Sri Lanka ended Day 3 at 265/8, resisting India’s bowlers through a determined lower-order fightback. Sonal Dinusha remained unbeaten on 85, while Pasindu Sooriyabandara scored 80. India had reduced Sri Lanka to 216/7 but failed to finish the innings. Dinusha’s partnerships with Keshara Nuwantha and Lahiru Kumara frustrated India, leaving Sri Lanka 38 runs short of avoiding the follow-on.

title: China's Xi Jinping to visit India with 400-member delegation for Brics: Report
content: Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to arrive in New Delhi for the upcoming BRICS summit next month. Accompanied by a robust delegation of around 400 officials, this visit marks a significant increase from his last attendance. This diplomatic mission comes at a crucial time as India and China aim to mend their relationship following past border conflicts.

title: Happy Onam 2026: Best wishes, quotes & messages for family and friends
content: Onam is a vibrant harvest festival celebrated with immense fervor in Kerala. This occasion sees the sharing of warm wishes and heartfelt messages, promoting joy and abundance among family and friends. Traditional practices such as crafting intricate pookalams and relishing the elaborate sadya form the heart of the festivities. Onam is a time when families come together to create cherished memories while deepening their connections.

title: Could Stutzle's comments change how Tkachuk's Senators exit is seen?
content: Tim Stutzle commented on the loss of Brady Tkachuk for the Ottawa Senators, saying the team has to worry about the team they have today and the team they hope to be in the future. The remarks were complimentary of Tkachuk as a teammate and player, but mentions of players wanting to stay in Ottawa fuelled speculation that the comments carried a subtle message. The NHL situation also underscores Ottawa’s changing leadership structure.

title: Curry gets candid in Ayesha's getaway post, paddling Canadian blue waters
content: Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry offered fans a glimpse of their peaceful kayaking getaway in Desolation Sound, British Columbia. Ayesha shared playful selfies and a short video from the water, while Stephen paddled behind her. The outing comes weeks after the couple celebrated their 15th wedding anniversary, highlighting the relaxed family and relationship moments they continue to make time for away from Stephen’s NBA career.

title: Could Jed York lose control of the 49ers after NFL punishment looms?
content: Jed York’s future as San Francisco 49ers owner is under scrutiny after he pleaded no contest to misdemeanor charges in Ohio. The NFL is reviewing the case under its personal conduct policy, leaving open the possibility of discipline. Legal experts say owners can face suspension or, in extreme cases, separation from the league. However, York’s removal is not automatic, and the NFL must first investigate the circumstances before deciding his fate.

title: CJP announces new organisational appointments, zone committees; full list
content: The Cockroach Janta Party announced fresh organisational expansion on Tuesday. New teams were appointed to strengthen its national network and local leadership. An organisation joint secretary and two national spokespersons were named. Coordination committees were formed for the north, west, and east zones. These appointments aim to build a stronger and more active party organisation.

title: 'I will continue to play for my father': Saransh gets emotional after India Test debut
content: Saransh Jain made his Test debut for India against Sri Lanka, becoming the country’s 320th Test player. He dedicated the achievement to his father, who inspired him to play cricket. Receiving his cap from Ravindra Jadeja made the moment special. Jadeja praised his domestic performances and advised him to enjoy the opportunity without feeling pressure.

title: Five labourers gunned down at construction site in Pakistan's Balochistan
content: the labourers were killed by unidentified gunmen in Saranan town, a provincial government official says . their bodies were sent to their hometowns in Punjab for burial . security forces have launched a search operation to track down the attackers .

title: A second chance: The uncertainty & struggle behind India's organ transplant boom
content: AP India’s transplant system has grown rapidly, from 4,990 transplants in 2013 to 20,138 in 2025 . but for a patient, a transplant is far more than a surgical procedure . it is a journey through medical tests, clearances, documentation, waiting, uncertainty, organ matching and, eventually, surgery and lifelong follow-up .

title: Florida’s Everglades face new threat from invasive eel worse than Burmese python
content: the Asian swamp eel spreads through wetlands and preys on fish, crayfish, frogs and other aquatic animals . the species is exceptionally difficult to control because it can survive periods of low water by burrowing into mud . some Everglades scientists warn its effects on the wetland food web could ultimately be more damaging than those of the notorious burmese python .

title: Tennessee company recycles old wind turbine blades into 99.9% pure glass fibre
content: carbon Rivers, a Knoxville-based advanced materials company, uses a heat-based process to separate glass fibre from the polymers and resins that hold turbine blades together . the technology has received millions of dollars in federal support and research collaboration with the University of Tennessee, Knoxville .

title: ‘We are under attack’: US military aircraft lands in Russia, sparks wild theories
content: the aircraft, operating as RCH4555, flew from Riga, Latvia, to Moscow . it departed Riga at 8:50am Moscow time and landed at Vnukovo shortly after 10am . a cameraman apparently joking, “we are under attack!” as the aircraft descended towards the airport .

title: A 2,500-year-old animal bone found in Sicily reveals how ancient people wrote on clay
content: stylus was found intact during preventive archaeological excavations at Orto Fontanelle, an area being investigated ahead of construction of a new cultural centre . its upper section carries a finely carved male head that experts interpret as probably representing an erma, or herm, of Dionysus, while the central section depicts an erect phallus .
